title: The Final Passenger
narration: The last passenger on my night bus refused to get off. At the terminal, every seat filled with people from roadside memorials along my route. A newspaper reported that seventeen passengers had died when their driver fell asleep, and my photograph appeared under the headline. I drove the route again, letting each ghost disappear where they had died. I wanted to leave immediately, but doing that would mean abandoning the only proof that any of this had happened. The silence felt deliberate, as though someone nearby was waiting for me to understand the trap before moving again. For several seconds I could hear nothing except my breathing and the small ordinary sounds around me. My stop never came because only seventeen bodies were recovered; the missing driver's body was mine.
